correctness.rationale: A minimal unique factor is non-prefix-comparable to any other minimal unique factor, so each start contributes at most one, giving M_a<=n_a. For u=av of length≥2, minimality forces v to repeat at a different position t; the preceding symbol there must differ from a, or u repeats. This contrasting position is injectively assigned: if two v begin at the same t they are prefix-comparable, forcing their corresponding minimal uniques to be prefix-comparable. Therefore M_a<=n−n_a; length-one unique-letter exception is handled separately. Summing yields the total bound, with de Bruijn cyclic witnesses attaining equality at n=q^r. Independently enumerated 5,320 small cyclic words directly by wraparound occurrence multiplicities.
residual_risks: Finite checks do not prove arbitrary word length; the injection is the unrestricted proof. Equality for every fixed composition is not claimed.

originality.rationale: The predecessor paper already proves the non-nesting property, algorithms and linearized de Bruijn extremality for minimum unique substrings. The assessed result is the new composition-sensitive per-start-symbol bound min(n_a,n−n_a) for directed cyclic factors, proved by an injection into positions bearing a different letter. This stronger sparse-composition bound is not stated by the inspected linear-string theorem, though the de Bruijn extremality mechanism is prior.
residual_risks: Cyclic stringology literature under other terms may contain a similar contrasting-symbol injection.
The claim establishes a sharp uniform coefficient along de Bruijn lengths; it does not characterize equality for every prescribed composition.

value.rationale: A natural content-dependent strengthening of the linear one-per-start upper bound for minimal unique factors of circular strings: it can reduce the count drastically when one symbol dominates, and de Bruijn sequences prove coefficient sharpness at infinitely many lengths. The bound is relevant to exact factor-spectrum and unique-marker enumeration with fixed letter counts.
residual_risks: The de Bruijn examples and general non-nesting are classical; novelty is restricted to per-letter contrasting-position bound.
